advisories.justification: The four type-erasing casts are intentionally surfaced for review. They read pointer-valued objects at their declared pointer width and do not perform byte-offset field access. They are required because the synchronized declarations are `char* const`, causing MWCC to fold three null initializers and break codegen. Making those definitions mutable also reaches the desired instruction shape, but regresses exact data sections and was rejected in the prior attempt. The localized reads preserve canonical data ownership and produce an exact target.
